permission_policies.reason: Official Workers documentation supports per-Worker Content Read-Only; legacy Workers Scripts Read grants product-level access and is not the minimal selection.

purpose: List account queues and read existence/consumer metadata
permission_policies.reason: Separate explicit queue read policy avoids assuming a per-Worker role authorizes account-wide Queues list. Queue inventory requires the exact account scope.

permission_policies.limitation: Account-level token metadata visibility may extend beyond self. No self-only scope is asserted. Future probe may fetch only the exact ID returned by its own verify response.

creator_prerequisite: Existing API Token Provisioning capability or existing Super Administrator membership; grantable token permissions must be a subset of the existing member permissions. Do not grant Admin to the token or escalate the member.
creation_procedure_future_separate_appro: Confirm exact account, existing creator capability, target Worker selection and absence of same-name token. Missing capability or target selection: STOP.
Prepare GitHub Repository secret input in the exact sandbox repository. If an existing secret now exists: STOP; do not overwrite it.
In Manage account > Account API tokens, prepare the exact name and three read-only policies above. Select Individual Workers > plm-serverless-sandbox-control for Content Read-Only. Do not create yet.

Review summary: exact account, exact single Worker, Queues Read and Account API Tokens Read only; no Write/Edit/Admin, D1, zone or platform-wide permissions. Missing choices or broader fallback required: STOP.

Only after separate explicit creation approval, user directly creates the token and transfers the one-time displayed value to the prepared GitHub Repository secret input without revealing it to the assistant. Credential entry and submission are performed by the user; no chat or file intermediary.
Verify secret name/scope/updated metadata only, then STOP. Do not start a workflow or API probe.
revocation_procedure_future_separate_app: Identify only this newly created token by recorded nonsecret token ID, exact name and account; do not guess IDs.

With separate revocation approval, the authorized owner revokes only that exact token in Account API tokens using existing account permissions. The read-only token cannot revoke itself and receives no Write permission for cleanup.
Any removal of the sandbox Repository secret requires separate explicit approval. Do not affect any other token or secret.
stop_conditions: ACCOUNT_OWNED creation unavailable with existing privileges
Existing GitHub secret would be overwritten
Secret handling requires assistant exposure or file retention
Exact zone absent: routes remain deferred
Any remote probe would be executed without separate approval
